scale.note: Every dimension is bipolar. -1 = fully the 'low' pole, 0 = neutral/average, +1 = fully the 'high' pole. Dimensions missing from a tag vector are 0.

dimensions.name: Empathy
dimensions.description: Feeling and caring about other people's emotions and suffering.

dimensions.name: Honesty
dimensions.description: Being straightforward and fair instead of using deceit or flattery to get ahead.

dimensions.name: Self-image
dimensions.description: How superior, special or entitled one feels compared to others.

dimensions.name: Admiration seeking
dimensions.description: Need for praise, status, recognition and being the centre of attention.

dimensions.name: Dominance
dimensions.description: Taking control, asserting oneself and steering others.

dimensions.name: Sociability
dimensions.description: Drawing energy from social contact and seeking out company.

dimensions.name: Anxiety
dimensions.description: Worry, fear of failure or rejection, and sensitivity to stress.

dimensions.name: Hostility
dimensions.description: Irritability, anger, holding grudges and retaliating.

dimensions.name: Discipline
dimensions.description: Planning, persistence, order and impulse control.

dimensions.name: Risk taking
dimensions.description: Seeking excitement and accepting danger or uncertainty for reward.

dimensions.name: Openness
dimensions.description: Interest in ideas, novelty, art and unconventional ways of thinking.

dimensions.name: Trust
dimensions.description: Assuming good intentions in others rather than hidden motives.

tags.name: Grandiose Narcissist
tags.description: Confident, charming and status-hungry; feels special and expects others to recognise it.

tags.name: Vulnerable Narcissist
tags.description: Craves validation but feels fragile; reacts to slights with shame, resentment or withdrawal.

tags.name: Strategist (Machiavellian)
tags.description: Calculating and patient; sees relationships as chess moves and keeps the real plan hidden.

tags.name: Daredevil (Psychopathic)
tags.description: Fearless, impulsive and callous; chases excitement with little guilt about who gets hurt.

tags.name: Caregiver
tags.description: Warm and selfless; notices what others need and puts it first.

tags.name: Leader
tags.description: Decisive and composed; takes charge, sets direction and stays steady under pressure.

tags.name: Performer
tags.description: Expressive and magnetic; lights up a room and loves an audience.

tags.name: Thinker
tags.description: Curious and independent; prefers ideas to small talk and is happy in their own head.

tags.name: Worrier
tags.description: Sensitive and cautious; anticipates what could go wrong and doubts their own worth.

tags.name: Perfectionist
tags.description: Driven by high standards; organised and reliable but hard on themselves and others.

tags.name: Adventurer
tags.description: Restless and bold; seeks new places, experiences and adrenaline.

tags.name: Peacemaker
tags.description: Patient and accommodating; avoids conflict and smooths things over.

tags.name: Rebel
tags.description: Independent and defiant; questions authority and breaks rules that don't make sense.

tags.name: Loner
tags.description: Private and self-reliant; keeps people at a distance and needs little from them.

tags.name: Guardian
tags.description: Dutiful and principled; values tradition, rules and keeping their word.
